title: Signature Unix One
description: The Signature Unix line distills fifty years of good ideas: small sharp tools, text streams, and a manual you can read cover to cover. Signature Unix One is the Signature-line answer to UNIX Seventh Edition — an original Unix variant by Justin Addam Higgins, never a copy of another maker's product. Study Seventh Edition and 4.3BSD to understand Unix's soul, Solaris and AIX to see commercial Unix at its peak, and illumos or FreeBSD to run that heritage today. It is engineered to the Signature standard: dependable, plain-spoken, and fully yours, with a deterministic build manifest so the exact same program rebuilds anywhere.
